📦 **meadow-womenjobs `c78b069`** — art: add four women craft occupations to production building casting

Add fishcurer_f_01, potter_f_01, glassmaker_f_01 and soapmaker_f_01 as new job keys for fish-salter, pottery, glassworks and soapworks. Existing female fisher remains. Four independently generated keyed originals were exhibited first in Gallery95c3c82, then processed for enclosed white pockets and packed as crafts4rows96x768. Preserve48existing configurations/raw images and all4old atlases byte-for-byte; child_share0.12 unchanged. No population or production changes.

Validation:52people metadata and atlas roundtrip, alpha0/255, margins, material edges, non-key pixels preserved and4natural recolour palettes inspected. Real current Blockside consumer selects all4new jobs over64building hashes each with10negative controls. Existing consumer2000agents/6000positions,9female variant jobs/40work uses,64building coverage pass.8invalid-config controls pass. Complete prompts/reference/original/game SHA256 and CPU scope in docs/evidence/womenjobs. Full WebGL scene and gallery browser interaction not tested.

Q0: current townWorkPrep reads TOWN_UNITS to skip battle-replaced buildings; the existing variants test fixture lacked that global and raised ReferenceError. Supply an empty TOWN_UNITS in the test fixture; no production algorithm change and no separate task needed.

Refs TASK-1050

👥 參與者：@meadow
